# mtncloud_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up one cluster by ID or by name, including one made in the console. A cluster is a managed group of hosts, for example a Kubernetes cluster. A name must match exactly one cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_cluster" "example" {
  name = "k8s-prod"
}

output "cluster_type" {
  value = data.mtncloud_cluster.example.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the cluster. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the cluster, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the cluster is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `group` (String) Group the cluster belongs to.
- `layout` (String) Layout the cluster was built from, or empty.
- `status` (String) Status, or empty.
- `type` (String) Cluster type, for example `Kubernetes Cluster`.
